product_one_liner.value: Ethos is an AI-powered expert network that helps organizations find vetted human expertise for research and consulting while matching professionals with paid expert opportunities.
product_one_liner.notes: TechCrunch describes the expert-network product and its organizational users; Ethos’s site describes access to vetted experts.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage provides no public pricing link or plans, and the checked /pricing URL returns a 404.

named_customers.notes: The sources reviewed describe customer categories and report 25+ private-equity firms, hedge funds, and consultancies, but do not name two customer organizations. No qualifying customer-logo or case-study source with named customers was found.

employee_band.notes: The available reporting says the company team had eight people in May 2026, and LinkedIn lists company size as 2–10; those counts fall outside the allowed bands. Other reported counts appear to include the much larger expert network rather than company staff, so no permitted band can be supported.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn identifies London as headquarters; the terms give the legal entity’s registered office in London, UK.

founded_year.notes: LinkedIn lists 2024 as the founding year; TechCrunch also reports the company was founded in 2024.

eng_blog.notes: I found no dedicated company blog or engineering-blog index to assess; company social posts and opportunity listings do not establish an engineering blog.

public_docs.notes: The homepage has no product documentation, help-center, or developer-portal link. Privacy, terms, and subprocessor/legal pages are not product documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The internal-role board showed no current listings in its open-jobs section, and Ethos’s AI Engineer employee opportunity is explicitly closed. Current expert marketplace opportunities, including data-science work for an external AI lab, are not Ethos AI/ML employee roles.

model_provider.value: Anthropic, Google (Gemini), OpenAI, Groq, and OpenRouter
model_provider.notes: Ethos’s subprocessor list names Anthropic, Google (specifically Gemini), OpenAI, Groq, and OpenRouter for AI, language-processing, inference, or model-routing services.

compliance_certs.notes: The privacy policy names UK GDPR and EU GDPR and says Ethos is responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable data-protection laws. It does not name SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, or PCI DSS.

last_funding.notes: TechCrunch reports a $22.75 million Series A announced May 6, 2026.

raised_18mo.notes: The Series A was announced in May 2026, within the 18-month period before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The internal-role board did not show current job titles. The Account Executive listing found on Ethos’s site is an expert opportunity for work with an external foundational AI lab, not an Ethos SDR/BDR/AE employee vacancy.

launched_6mo.notes: I found no product or major-feature launch dated from 2026-05-09 through 2026-11-09 in the readable company announcements. The latest launch-like product announcement found was TechCrunch’s coverage of voice onboarding on 2026-05-06, before the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The available sources identify the co-founders but do not provide a sufficiently complete, checkable team roster or dated evidence establishing whether a C-level or VP-level person joined or left during the period.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Ethos lists Apollo as a subprocessor for B2B sales intelligence and lead generation. This is a visible sales-stack signal; the page does not identify Apollo specifically as the company’s CRM.
